## Summary

Describe what this change does and why it is needed.

## Change type

- [ ] `feat`: new user-visible capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: internal change without changed behaviour
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: test-only change
- [ ] `build`: build or dependency change
- [ ] `ci`: workflow change
- [ ] `chore`: repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files`
- [ ] Audio playback tested if relevant
- [ ] Numerical output compared with Python reference if DSP changed

## Breaking changes

Describe any breaking changes or write `None`.

## Release impact

- [ ] No release
- [ ] Patch
- [ ] Minor
- [ ] Major
